name: DropOut Saga
source: You play as a minor mob leader who wishes to leave the organization you work for because of medical complications affecting your mental health, but you're only allowed to leave it if all other major leaders vote in your favor, allowing you to leave peacefully. In order to sway your bosses, you're sent to an education facility undercover as the Headmaster. There, you're supposed to gather enough material that can be used to blackmail important politicians and cool off the heat your soon-to-be former employers are having. Most of the game scenes take place at a fictional private rich young adults' college. There you find the daughters and sons of every politician, bureaucrat, chief of police, or aristocrat in the city.​
translation: 你將扮演一名級別不高的幫派頭目。醫療問題影響了你的心理健康，因此你希望退出所屬組織，但只有在其他主要頭目全數投票支持後，才能和平離開。為了說服上司，你被派往一所教育機構臥底，擔任校長。在那裡，你必須蒐集足夠的把柄，用來勒索重要政客，並替即將成為前僱主的組織減輕壓力。遊戲大部分場景發生在一所虛構的富家子弟私立學院；城裡每位政客、官僚、警察局長或貴族的兒女都在此就讀。
